definition: Evidence or actions are assigned to the wrong patient episode admission stay index event or analysis boundary.
excludes: Wrong time for the correct event is R-TIME.

definition: The investigation uses the wrong time source sequence window baseline position or pre/post distinction.
excludes: Whether an event occurred at all is R-PROV.

definition: Codes orders summaries or unsupported assertions substitute for evidence of performed events or clinical states.
excludes: Incomplete search across appropriate sources is R-COVER.

definition: The investigation omits required streams values candidates medications complication classes or follow-up.
excludes: Retrieved but conflicting or unresolved evidence is R-UNCERT.

definition: The investigation conflates clinically distinct states such as ordered versus performed or planned versus unplanned.
excludes: Formal threshold algorithm or pathway errors are R-RULE.

definition: The investigation applies an incorrect formula threshold hierarchy composite definition score or pathway.
excludes: Ignored contraindications or justified deviations are R-CONTEXT.

definition: The investigation asserts diagnosis intent causation documentation or a general conclusion beyond the available evidence.
excludes: Simple substitution of an invalid source is R-PROV.

definition: The system returns a definitive conclusion despite missing sparse conflicting or multiply interpretable evidence.
excludes: Incomplete retrieval without false closure is R-COVER.

definition: The investigation ignores indication contraindication refusal documented justification goals or historical availability.
excludes: Generic calculation or pathway errors are R-RULE.
